edited_fraction: whole network for written MLPs (113-1,825 weights); readout edits touch only the last layer (64-256 of 9-30M weights)
evidence_notes: Writing small property-prediction networks from domain knowledge in audited no-tool replies is the main study (p.1-6; prompt p.17), so direct_values; reading and readout editing are in Supplement S3 (p.58-59), with a five-attempt feedback arm, hence both protocols. Only the BO selection rule was 'fixed before the 20-seed runs, after a pilot' (p.5) with no registry or timestamp, so prereg none; code 'will be released' at a GitHub URL (p.15), so not released. Text, figures and analysis code were drafted with an AI assistant (p.15); bulk-modulus knowledge is mostly the inverse-volume rule (p.6), and permuted-weight controls edited as well as real weights (p.59).
